title: Degenerate PCR and sequencing workflow for discovering PET hydrolases from Japanese composts
author: Ryo Iizuka
materials: DNA was extracted by bitBiome Inc. (Tokyo, Japan) using the QIAamp PowerFecal Pro DNA Kit (QIAGEN, Hilden, Germany) according to the manufacturer's protocol.

The colony PCR amplicons were purified using NucleoSpin Gel and PCR Clean-up and sequenced bidirectionally using the vector-specific primers described in Step 10 by the Sanger method at Eurofins Genomics K.K. (Tokyo, Japan) using a 3730xl DNA Analyzer (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Waltham, MA) with the BigDye Terminator v3.1 Cycle Sequencing Kit (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
DNA was extracted by bitBiome Inc. (Tokyo, Japan) using the QIAamp PowerFecal Pro DNA Kit (QIAGEN, Hilden, Germany) according to the manufacturer's protocol.

steps.title: Collect compost samples
steps.instruction: Collect Compost 1 from Miyakojima City Resources Recycling Center (24°45'15.1" N 125°19'52.2" E) on 13 June 2016 into a sterile 50 mL centrifuge tube; transport on dry ice and store at –80 °C within one week. Collect Compost 2 from Kurkku Fields, Chiba (35°19'33.5" N 139°58'53.4" E) on 14 March 2024 into a clean paper cup; transport at ambient temperature and store at 4 °C until DNA extraction.

steps.title: Extract DNA with ISOIL kit
steps.instruction: Extract DNA from each compost sample using the ISOIL kit (Nippon Gene, Tokyo, Japan) following the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: First PCR with TaKaRa Ex Premier
steps.instruction: Set up PCR using TaKaRa Ex Premier DNA Polymerase (Takara Bio, Kusatsu, Japan) and degenerate primers (Fw 5′-ATGGMSAACCCSTACGAGCGCGG-3′, Rev 5′-GWRSGGGCAGKTGSMSCGGTACT-3′). Run: initial denaturation 94 °C for 1 min; 30 cycles of 98 °C for 10 s, 57 °C for 15 s, and 68 °C for 25 s.

steps.title: Second PCR with TaKaRa Ex Premier
steps.instruction: Perform a second PCR with the same degenerate primers using TaKaRa Ex Premier DNA Polymerase (Takara Bio). Cycle: initial denaturation 94 °C for 1 min; 30 cycles of 98 °C for 10 s and 68 °C for 30 s.

steps.title: Gel‑extract and purify amplicons
steps.instruction: Excise the ~800–900 bp PCR products from an agarose gel and purify them with the NucleoSpin Gel and PCR Clean‑up kit (MACHEREY‑NAGEL, Düren, Germany) according to the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Re‑amplify purified amplicons
steps.instruction: Re‑amplify the purified amplicons using TaKaRa Ex Taq Hot Start Version (Takara Bio) with the same primer set under 30 cycles of 98 °C for 10 s, 55 °C for 30 s, and 72 °C for 1 min.

steps.title: Purify and clone into pTAC‑1
steps.instruction: Purify the re‑amplified products with NucleoSpin Gel and PCR Clean‑up, ligate into the pTAC‑1 vector using the FEW Blue TA Cloning Kit (BioDynamics Laboratory, Tokyo, Japan) per the kit protocol, and transform the ligation mix into E. coli XL10‑Gold competent cells.

steps.title: Confirm inserts by colony PCR
steps.instruction: Screen transformants by colony PCR using KOD One PCR Master Mix (Toyobo, Osaka, Japan) with vector‑specific primers (Fw 5′-GTAAAACGACGGCCAGT-3′, Rev 5′-CAGGAAACAGCTATGAC-3′) under 30 cycles of 98 °C for 10 s, 55 °C for 5 s, and 68 °C for 1 s. Select clones showing the expected ~1,000 bp insert for sequencing.

steps.title: Assess sequencing quality
steps.instruction: Inspect chromatograms with ApE software (versions 2.0.53 and 3.1.4); assemble forward and reverse reads into consensus sequences; discard clones with ambiguous assemblies or frameshifts that disrupt the open reading frame.

steps.title: Search homologous proteins
steps.instruction: Submit each deduced amino‑acid sequence to BLASTP against the NCBI ClusteredNR database.

steps.title: Perform phylogenetic analysis
steps.instruction: Align sequences with ClustalW (default parameters) in MEGA v12.1.2; construct a neighbor‑joining tree with 1,000 bootstrap replicates. Additionally, align the 53 amplicon amino‑acid sequences with four reference PET hydrolases (LCC, TfCut2, PHL7, PHL1) using Clustal Omega and visualise the alignment with ESPript 3.0.
